r01.note: Without 'my' it is an error, but 'This is Father.' works when 'Father' is used as a name for one's own father, a capitalised form of address.

r02.note: Without 'my' it is an error, but 'This is Grandfather.' works when 'Grandfather' is used as a name, a capitalised form of address.

r10.note: 'more red' is a widely accepted comparative for colour adjectives and is used about as often as 'redder', so labelling it wrong teaches something false.
